name: Pre-boarding chat — Priya Nair
turns: Hi! I start at Fernhill on October 12 as a senior software engineer on the robot-fleet team. I'm moving from Austin to Denver for the job and will work from the Denver office.
Welcome, Priya! I'll put together everything you need for your first week. Is there anything personal I should keep in mind while I prepare it?
Two things. My partner and I are expecting our first child at the end of November, so I need to understand parental leave early. And I'd prefer a Linux laptop — I've used Ubuntu for ten years.
Noted: first child due at the end of November, and a Linux laptop. I'll pull the parental leave policy that applies to you before your first day.
Thanks. One more: I'll travel to the Boston lab for two days in my first month, so the travel expense rules would help too.
Got it — a two-day Boston lab trip in your first month. I'll include the travel meal rules in your onboarding brief.
